description: Multi-branch support: database migration, branch service layer, branch context, branch switcher in TopNav, branch management settings page, and update sidebar/routing
steps: Create supabase/migrations/008_multi_branch_barcode.sql with: barcode/barcode_format columns on products, idx_products_barcode index, branch_settings table, user_branch_access table with RLS policies and indexes (exact SQL from task spec)
Create src/services/branches/types.ts with Branch, BranchSettings, UserBranchAccess types
Create src/services/branches/branches.ts with CRUD operations for branches and user assignment using supabase client (following pattern from src/hooks/useWarehouses.ts)
Create src/services/branches/context.ts exporting branch filtering helpers

Create src/contexts/BranchContext.tsx - global branch selection context that stores active branch (from profile or user selection), persists in localStorage, provides activeBranchId to all consumers. Super Admin can select 'All Branches', branch managers auto-locked to their assigned branch
Add BranchProvider wrapping in src/main.tsx (inside AuthProvider, outside SidebarProvider)
Create src/hooks/useBranches.ts with useBranches, useCreateBranch, useUpdateBranch, useDeleteBranch, useUserBranchAccess hooks
Create src/components/layout/BranchSwitcher.tsx - dropdown in TopNav showing branch name + city, 'All Branches' option for super admin, emerald colored badge for active branch, glass dropdown styling
Update src/components/layout/TopNav.tsx to include BranchSwitcher between the AI bot icon and notifications bell

Create src/pages/settings/Branches.tsx - full branch management page with CRUD for branches, user assignment, branch-level settings display, branch performance comparison cards. Use glass card styling, DataTable, and emerald accents
Update src/App.tsx to add the lazy import for Branches page and route: path='settings/branches' element={<Branches />}
Update src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx to add 'Branches' nav item under Settings section using Building2 icon from lucide-react, href='/settings/branches'
acceptance_criteria: Migration file 008 exists with correct SQL for branch_settings, user_branch_access tables, barcode columns, and indexes
BranchContext provides activeBranchId and setBranch function to the entire app
Branch switcher appears in TopNav and allows switching between branches
Settings > Branches page renders with branch list and CRUD UI
Route /settings/branches works and is accessible from sidebar
pnpm build passes with zero TypeScript errors
findings: Build passes cleanly. The Branch type in database.ts was extended with optional code and state fields to match the migration schema. BranchProvider is placed inside AuthProvider and outside SidebarProvider as specified. All acceptance criteria met.
